name: KA-Gold Bot
summary: KA-Gold Bot is a trend-following Expert Advisor designed for gold (XAUUSD) trading. It uses a combination of moving averages and momentum indicators to identify trend direction and enter trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. The EA includes built-in risk management with stop loss and take profit levels, and is optimized for gold's volatility characteristics.
summary_zh: KA-Gold Bot是一个专为黄金(XAUUSD)交易设计的趋势跟踪智能交易系统。它结合移动平均线和动量指标来识别趋势方向,并沿主导趋势方向入场交易。该EA内置了止损和止盈级别的风险管理,并针对黄金的波动特性进行了优化。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用趋势跟踪策略,核心逻辑是基于移动平均线的交叉和价格动量来判断黄金市场的趋势方向。入场条件通常包括快速均线穿越慢速均线,同时配合动量指标(如RSI或MACD)确认趋势强度,在多头趋势成立时买入,空头趋势成立时卖出。出场条件包括预设的止损和止盈水平,以及趋势反转信号触发时的主动平仓。仓位管理方面,EA允许用户自定义手数或采用基于账户余额的动态仓位计算方式。资金管理通过固定止损点数和风险比例来控制每笔交易的最大亏损额度,但缺乏对整体仓位和最大回撤的全局控制机制。策略针对黄金的高波动性进行了参数优化,但在震荡市中可能频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a trend-following strategy with its core logic based on moving average crossovers and price momentum to determine gold market trend direction. Entry conditions typically involve a fast moving average crossing a slow moving average, confirmed by momentum indicators such as RSI or MACD to validate trend strength, buying in uptrends and selling in downtrends. Exit conditions include preset stop loss and take profit levels, as well as active position closing when trend reversal signals are triggered. Position sizing allows users to define fixed lot sizes or use dynamic calculation based on account balance. Money management controls maximum loss per trade through fixed stop loss pips and risk ratios, but lacks global controls for overall exposure and maximum drawdown. The strategy parameters are optimized for gold's high volatility characteristics, but may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号,用于识别订单

pros: 策略逻辑清晰,基于经典的趋势跟踪方法,易于理解和验证
针对黄金市场特性进行了优化,止损止盈设置考虑了黄金的高波动性
内置点差过滤和追踪止损功能,提供了一定的风险保护
参数可调性强,用户可以根据不同市场环境灵活调整策略参数
使用魔术编号管理订单,支持多EA同时运行而不产生冲突
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on classic trend-following methods, easy to understand and verify
Optimized for gold market characteristics with SL/TP settings accounting for gold's high volatility
Built-in spread filter and trailing stop providing some risk protection
Highly configurable parameters allowing users to adapt to different market conditions
Uses magic number for order management, supporting multiple EAs running simultaneously without conflicts
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号和连续亏损
缺乏对整体仓位和最大回撤的全局控制机制,多笔交易同时运行时风险可能失控
没有新K线检查机制,可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
动态仓位计算可能在高杠杆下放大风险
缺乏对重要新闻事件和市场时段的过滤,可能在低流动性时段产生不利交易
cons_en: Trend-following strategy prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Lacks global controls for overall exposure and maximum drawdown, risking uncontrolled exposure with multiple simultaneous trades
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening repeated positions on the same candle
Dynamic lot sizing may amplify risk under high leverage
Lacks filtering for major news events and trading sessions, potentially generating unfavorable trades during low liquidity periods
improvements: 增加震荡市识别机制(如ADX指标),在盘整行情中自动暂停交易或切换策略
添加最大回撤限制和最大同时持仓数量控制,实现全局风险管理
引入新K线检查和交易时段过滤,避免重复开仓和低流动性时段的不利交易
improvements_en: Add ranging market detection (e.g., ADX indicator) to automatically pause trading or switch strategies during consolidation
Implement maximum drawdown limits and maximum simultaneous position controls for global risk management
Introduce new bar checks and trading session filters to avoid repeated entries and unfavorable trades during low liquidity

risk_points: 缺乏新K线检查机制,可能在同一根K线上重复开仓导致过度持仓
趋势策略在震荡市中会产生连续亏损,缺乏自动暂停机制
动态仓位计算在高杠杆环境下可能放大单笔交易风险
risk_points_en: No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening repeated positions on the same candle leading to overexposure
Trend strategy generates consecutive losses in ranging markets without auto-pause mechanism
Dynamic lot sizing may amplify per-trade risk under high leverage conditions
